facts.text: Salamander Middleburg sits on 340 acres in Virginia's horse and wine country.
facts.excerpt: Salamander Middleburg is perched on 340 scenic acres in the heart of Virginia’s horse and wine country

facts.text: Salamander Middleburg is part of Sheila C. Johnson's Salamander Collection.
facts.excerpt: A stylish addition to Sheila C. Johnson’s Salamander Collection

facts.text: The resort's spa covers 23,000 square feet.
facts.excerpt: unwind in the 23,000-square-foot spa
